posts.text:
The Asahi project was all about taking something closed and restricted and opening it up.

Adding new restrictions that make it harder for other projects to build on that is not the way. And that AI rejection is just silly. https://t.co/fT4O4wieQm
posts.text_zh:
Asahi 项目的初衷，就是把封闭、受限的东西打开。

再加上新的限制、让其他项目更难在它基础上构建，这不是正确的做法。而那种对 AI 的排斥简直荒唐。 https://t.co/fT4O4wieQm
